title: Improvement of flatness in annuli
summary: We present a short and flexible improvement-of-flatness argument adapted to the setting of exterior domains, where one is naturally led to work with annuli instead of balls. As a model application in the classical setting of minimal surfaces, we give an alternative proof of the end-structure and asymptotics for finite Morse index minimal hypersurfaces with Euclidean area growth in low dimensions. The method is largely PDE-based and general in its application. Suitable variants have been employed in Bernoulli and Allen--Cahn settings.
